<script id="rules">/* Cabinet practice rules. Each round settles against its own theme and level. */
(function(root){
  "use strict";
  const positions = ["Left","Middle","Right"];
  const common = {A:"Dollar",H:"Gold bars",L:"Diamond"};
  const games = {
    vault:{title:"Piggy Vault",names:{...common,W:"Pig wild",K:"King",J:"Jack"},points:{A:20,H:10,L:40,K:25,J:15},wild:"pig",guide:["LAH","LWH","LHA"],guideMove:{reel:2,dir:"up"}},
    jungle:{title:"Jungle Crown",art:{"A":"jaguar-idol","H":"jade-frog","L":"sun-medallion"},names:{A:"Jaguar idol",H:"Jade frog",L:"Sun medallion",W:"Ape wild"},points:{A:5,H:10,L:25},wild:"jungle-icon",guide:["AWL","HWL","WHA"],guideMove:{reel:2,dir:"down"}},
    pirate:{title:"Ruby Corsair",art:{"A":"ruby","H":"doubloons","L":"spyglass"},names:{A:"Crimson ruby",H:"Doubloons",L:"Spyglass",W:"Captain wild"},points:{A:10,H:40,L:30},wild:"pirate-icon",guide:["HWA","ALH","LWH"],guideMove:{reel:1,dir:"up"}},
    buffalo:{title:"Bison Blaze",art:{A:"buffalo-icon",H:"buffalo-icon"},names:{A:"Red bison",H:"Gold bison",L:"Diamond",W:"Bison wild"},points:{A:50,H:20,L:30},wild:"buffalo-icon",guide:["HAL","LAH","ALH"],guideMove:{reel:2,dir:"down"}},
    harbor:{title:"Harbor Lights",art:{A:"quay-flag",H:"quay-bell",L:"quay-pearl"},names:{A:"Signal flag",H:"Bell",L:"Pearl",W:"Beacon wild"},points:{A:80,H:20,L:35},wild:"quay-beacon",guide:["LHA","AHL","HAL"],guideMove:{reel:2,dir:"down"}},
    train:{title:"Midnight Express",art:{"A":"ticket","H":"rail-gold","L":"rail-lantern"},names:{A:"Express ticket",H:"Gold bars",L:"Rail lantern",W:"Engine wild"},points:{A:5,H:30,L:20},wild:"train-icon",guide:["AHL","LHA","HAL"],guideMove:{reel:2,dir:"down"}}
  };
  for (const [id, game] of Object.entries(games)) {
    if (id === "vault") continue;
    Object.assign(game.names, {K: "King", J: "Jack"});
    Object.assign(game.points, {K: 10, J: 5});
  }
  const templates = [
    ["LAH","HAL","AHL"], ["HLA","ALH","HHL"], ["AHL","LHA","HLA"],
    ["LWH","HAL","AHL"], ["AWH","HLA","LAH"], ["ALH","HWL","LAH"],
    ["HAL","LWH","AHL"], ["LAH","AHL","HLA"], ["LAH","HAL","LHL"],
    ["HAH","LAL","AHA"], ["AHA","LHL","HLH"], ["AWL","HWL","WHA"],
    ["ALH","LWA","AWH"], ["AWH","AHL","LHA"]
  ];
  const orders = [[0,1,2],[2,0,1],[1,2,0],[0,2,1],[2,1,0],[1,0,2]];
  const deckKinds=["single","single","wild","compare","none","tie","none","compare"];
  function visible(board,move=null) {
    return board.map((strip,i)=>{
      const start = move && move.reel===i ? (move.dir==="up"?2:0) : 1;
      return strip.slice(start,start+3);
    });
  }
  function line(board,move=null){return visible(board,move).map(strip=>strip[1]);}
  function award(id,symbols) {
    if(symbols.includes("-"))return 0;
    const real=symbols.filter(s=>s!=="W"), wilds=3-real.length, g=games[id];
    if (!real.length) return id==="harbor"?35:id==="jungle"?100:Math.max(...Object.values(g.points));
    if(id==="harbor" && real.includes("A") && wilds) return 0;
    if(real.every(s=>s===real[0])){
      const base=g.points[real[0]];
      if(id==="vault" && symbols[1]==="W") return base+10;
      if(id==="pirate" && wilds===2) return base+20;
      if(id==="train" && !wilds && real[0]==="H") return base+15;
      return base;
    }
    if(id==="buffalo" && real.every(s=>s==="A"||s==="H")){
      const red=real.filter(s=>s==="A").length;
      return red+wilds>=2?12:6;
    }
    return 0;
  }
  function moves(id,board,level=1){
    return positions.flatMap((_,reel)=>["up","down"].map(dir=>{
      const move={reel,dir};
      return {...move,value:award(id,line(board,move))*level};
    }));
  }
  function mix(items,random){
    const list=items.slice();
    for(let i=list.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(random()*(i+1));[list[i],list[j]]=[list[j],list[i]];}
    return list;
  }
  const pick=(items,random)=>items[Math.floor(random()*items.length)];
  const catalogs=new Map();
  function catalog(id){
    if(catalogs.has(id))return catalogs.get(id);
    const pool={single:[],wild:[],none:[],compare:[],tie:[]};
    const seen=new Set();
    for(const t of templates)for(const order of orders)for(const perm of orders){
      const symbol={A:"AHL"[perm[0]],H:"AHL"[perm[1]],L:"AHL"[perm[2]],W:"W"};
      const row=order.map(i=>Array.from(t[i],s=>symbol[s]).join(""));
      if(id==="vault"&&(row[0].includes("W")||row[2].includes("W")))continue;
      const key=row.join("");if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);
      const board=row.map(strip=>"A"+strip+"A");
      if(award(id,line(board)))continue;
      const vals=moves(id,board).filter(m=>m.value>0);
      if(!vals.length){pool.none.push(row);continue;}
      const values=new Set(vals.map(m=>m.value));
      if(values.size>1)pool.compare.push(row);
      else if(vals.length>1)pool.tie.push(row);
      else pool.single.push(row);
      if(vals.some(m=>line(board,m).includes("W")))pool.wild.push(row);
    }
    catalogs.set(id,pool);return pool;
  }
  function wrap(row,random){return row.map(strip=>pick("AHL",random)+strip+pick("AHL",random));}
  function deal(id,random=Math.random){
    const pool=catalog(id), used=new Set();
    return [wrap(games[id].guide,random),...mix(deckKinds,random).map(kind=>{
      const fresh=pool[kind].filter(row=>!used.has(row.join("")));
      const chosen=pick(fresh.length?fresh:pool[kind],random);used.add(chosen.join(""));
      return wrap(chosen.map(strip=>random()<.5?Array.from(strip).reverse().join(""):strip),random);

  const rules={games,positions,deal,line,visible,award,moves,label,practicePool:catalog};
  root.BrasslineRules=Object.freeze(rules);
  if(typeof module!=="undefined"&&module.exports)module.exports=rules;
})(globalThis);
</script>
<script id="drill-model">/* Doubletake shares the cabinet's posted paytables and one-nudge scorer. */
(function (scope) {
  "use strict";
  const rules = scope.BrasslineRules;
  function newSet(game, level, random = Math.random) {
    const [guide, ...deck] = rules.deal(game, random);
    const awards = board => rules.moves(game, board).map(move => move.value);
    const blank = deck.find(board => awards(board).every(value => value === 0));
    const comparison = deck.find(board => new Set(awards(board).filter(value => value > 0)).size > 1);
    const finish = comparison || deck.find(board => board !== blank && awards(board).some(Boolean));
    const starter = deck.find(board => board !== finish && awards(board).some(Boolean)) || guide;
    const boards = [starter, blank, finish];
    for(let i=boards.length-1;i>0;i--){
      const j=Math.floor(random()*(i+1));
      [boards[i],boards[j]]=[boards[j],boards[i]];
    }
    const rounds = boards.map(board => ({ board, choice: null }));
    return {game, level, rounds, index: 0, phase: "pick"};
  }
  function evaluate(set, round, choice) {
    const moves = rules.moves(set.game, round.board, set.level);
    const highest = Math.max(...moves.map(move => move.value));
    const value = choice === 6 ? 0 : moves[choice].value;
    return {value, highest, best: highest ? value === highest : choice === 6, moves};
  }
  function choose(set, choice) {
    if (set.phase !== "pick" || !Number.isInteger(choice) || choice < 0 || choice > 6) return;
    const round = set.rounds[set.index];
    round.choice = choice;
    set.phase = "reveal";
  }
  function next(set) {
    if (set.phase === "reveal") {
      if (set.index + 1 === set.rounds.length) set.phase = "summary";
      else {set.index++; set.phase = "pick";}
    }
  }
  function wonRound(set, round) {
    return round.choice !== null && evaluate(set, round, round.choice).best;
  }
  function bonusValues(random = Math.random) {
    const values = [5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30];
    for (let i=values.length-1; i>0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(random()*(i+1));
      [values[i], values[j]] = [values[j], values[i]];
    }
    return values.slice(0,4);
  }
  scope.Doubletake = {newSet, choose, evaluate, next, wonRound, bonusValues};
})(globalThis);
</script>

<script id="circuit-model">(function(root) {
  "use strict";
  const R=root.BrasslineRules, F=root.FleetPracticeCircuit;
  const skills={

    empty:"Read a stop with no nudge",exception:"Apply the cabinet rule",lines:"Count active lines"
  };
  const stations=[
    ["raise","vault","train"],["lower","jungle","pirate"],["compare","pirate","vault"],
    ["wild","buffalo","jungle"],["empty","train","buffalo"],["exception","harbor","train"],["lines","vault","harbor"]
  ].map(([skill,context,alternate])=>({skill,context,alternate}));
  const paths=[
    ["Top",[0,0,0]],["Center",[1,1,1]],["Bottom",[2,2,2]],
    ["Falling diagonal",[0,1,2]],["Rising diagonal",[2,1,0]]
  ];
  function trace(id,board){
    const strips=R.visible(board);
    return paths.map(([name,rows])=>{
      const symbols=rows.map((row,i)=>strips[i][row]);
      return {name,rows,symbols,value:R.award(id,symbols)};
    });
  }
  function select(items,random){return items[Math.floor(random()*items.length)];}
  const pad=strips=>strips.map(strip=>"H"+strip+"L");

    const {skill,context:id}=station;
    let board;
    if(skill==="exception"){
      // Flags cannot substitute through a beacon. On the alternate cabinet pure gold earns a bonus.
      let strips=id==="harbor"?["LAH","LWH","AHL"]:["LHL","HAW","AHL"];
      strips=strips.map(strip=>random()<.5?strip.split("").reverse().join(""):strip);
      if(random()<.5)strips.reverse();
      board=pad(strips);
    }else if(skill==="lines"){
      // Independent symbols on each strip produce a varied tally kept small enough to inspect.
      for(let attempt=0;attempt<80;attempt++){
        const candidate=pad(Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>Array.from({length:3},()=>select(i===1?"HLW":"HL",random)).join("")));
        const count=trace(id,candidate).filter(l=>l.value).length;

          return best.length===1 && best[0].dir===(skill==="raise"?"up":"down") && !row.some(strip=>strip.includes("W"));
        });

  }
  function grade(r,choice){

<script id="bonus-model">const BrassBonus = (() => {
  // Each entry uses the same three skill families in the order catch, echo, timing.
  const themes = {
    vault: {titles:["Mintfall","Teller’s Code","Vault Dial"], object:"mint bond", lamps:["Bronze","Silver","Gold"], timed:"Lock the dial", finish:"Vault counted", accent:"#ffd176", icon:"bars"},
    jungle:{titles:["Canopy Catch","Temple Echo","Vine Swing"], object:"sun medallion", lamps:["Root","Vine","Crown"], timed:"Release the vine", finish:"Treasure recovered", accent:"#bcf176", icon:"sun-medallion"},
    pirate:{titles:["Doubloon Squall","Smuggler’s Signal","Anchor Drop"],object:"doubloon", lamps:["Port","Mast","Bow"], timed:"Drop anchor",finish:"Cargo secured",accent:"#ffa399",icon:"doubloons"},
    buffalo:{titles:["Prairie Gold","Thunder Trail","Canyon Leap"],object:"bison medallion",lamps:["Mesa","Creek","Ridge"],timed:"Make the leap",finish:"Herd home",accent:"#ffbd72",icon:"buffalo-icon"},
    harbor:{titles:["Pearl Dive","Beacon Watch","Tide Gate"],object:"pearl",lamps:["Pier","Light","Buoy"],timed:"Cross the gate",finish:"Safe in harbor",accent:"#86efe9",icon:"quay-pearl"},
    train:{titles:["Midnight Mail","Switchyard","Golden Spike"],object:"express ticket",lamps:["West","Yard","East"],timed:"Drive the spike",finish:"Express arrived",accent:"#a8d8ff",icon:"ticket"}
  };
  const kinds=["mint","signal","dial"];
  const records=new WeakMap();
  const quietSpins=4;
  const featureChance={landed:1/10, nudged:1/6};
  function earn(s, rng=Math.random){
    if(!themes[s.id] || s.lesson!==null || !s.paidSpinNumber || s.phase!=="settled" || s.win<=0 ||
        !Object.hasOwn(featureChance,s.outcome))return false;
    const old=records.get(s);
    if(old && (old.spin===s.spins || old.ticket))return false;
    const record={spin:s.spins,ticket:null};records.set(s,record);
    if(s.paidSpinNumber<=s.bonusPace.quietThrough || rng()>=featureChance[s.outcome])return false;
    // A nudge can be completed on a cabinet the player visited earlier.
    s.bonusPace.quietThrough=s.bonusPace.paidSpins+quietSpins;
    const index=Math.floor(rng()*kinds.length);
    record.ticket={kind:kinds[index],title:themes[s.id].titles[index],level:s.level,started:false};
    return true;
  }
  function ready(s,kind){
    const ticket=records.get(s)?.ticket;
    return !!ticket && (!kind || ticket.kind===kind);
  }
  function begin(s){
    const ticket=records.get(s)?.ticket;
    if(!ticket || ticket.started)return null;
    ticket.started=true;
    return {kind:ticket.kind,title:ticket.title,s,ticket,level:ticket.level,round:0,hits:0,points:0,phase:"intro",sequence:[],step:0};
  }
  function wave(b,rng=Math.random){
    if(!["intro","between"].includes(b.phase)||b.round>=3)return false;
    b.round++;b.step=0;
    if(b.kind==="mint"){
      b.sequence=[5,10,25].map(n=>n*b.level);
      for(let i=2;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(rng()*(i+1));[b.sequence[i],b.sequence[j]]=[b.sequence[j],b.sequence[i]];}
    }else if(b.kind==="signal"){
      b.sequence=Array.from({length:b.round+1},()=>Math.floor(rng()*3));
    }else{
      b.target=42+Math.floor(rng()*49);
      b.width=16-2*b.round;
    }
    b.phase=b.kind==="signal"?"listen":"choose";
    return true;
  }
  function take(b,i){
    if(b.phase!=="choose" || !Number.isInteger(i) || i<0 || i>(b.kind==="dial"?100:2))return false;
    if(b.kind==="dial"){
      const error=Math.abs(i-b.target);
      b.accuracy=error<=b.width/3?"Bullseye":error<=b.width?"Inside the band":"Outside the band";
      const amount=error<=b.width/3?25:error<=b.width?10:0;
      b.points+=amount*b.level;if(amount)b.hits++;
    }else{
      if(b.kind==="signal" && b.sequence[b.step]!==i){b.phase="between";return true;}
      b.step++;
      if(b.kind==="signal" && b.step<b.sequence.length)return true;
      b.points+=b.kind==="mint"?b.sequence[i]:b.round*15*b.level;b.hits++;

  }

    if(!b || b.phase==="done" || (!early && (b.round!==3 || b.phase!=="between")))return false;

    b.s.score+=b.points;b.s.lastBonusWin=b.points;
    return true;
  }
  return {themes,ready,earn,begin,wave,take,finish};
})();

    particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
    for(const p of particles){
      p.life-=step;p.x+=p.vx*step;p.y+=p.vy*step;p.vy+=step*.64;p.angle+=step*p.turn;
      ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x*w,p.y*h);ctx.rotate(p.angle);ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,p.life*1.9);ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      if(owner==="harbor"||owner==="buffalo"){ctx.arc(0,0,p.size,0,Math.PI*2);}
      else if(owner==="jungle"){ctx.ellipse(0,0,p.size*.42,p.size*1.4,.3,0,Math.PI*2);}
      else if(owner==="pirate"){ctx.moveTo(0,-p.size);ctx.lineTo(p.size,0);ctx.lineTo(0,p.size*1.4);ctx.lineTo(-p.size,0);ctx.closePath();}
      else if(owner==="train"){ctx.roundRect(-1,-p.size,2.5,p.size*2,1);}
      else{ctx.ellipse(0,0,p.size*(.28+.72*Math.abs(Math.cos(p.angle))),p.size,0,0,Math.PI*2);}
      ctx.fill();
      if(owner==="vault"||owner==="harbor"){ctx.strokeStyle="#fff2c9";ctx.lineWidth=1.1;ctx.stroke();}
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if(particles.length)frame=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  function burst(id,count,final=false){
    if(reduced.matches||!ctx)return;
    owner=id;const colors=palettes[id];
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      const left=i%2===0;
      particles.push({x:final?(left?.12:.88):.5,y:final?.8:.58,vx:(final?(left?1:-1)*(.1+Math.random()*.45):(Math.random()-.5)*.8),
        vy:-.24-Math.random()*(final?.98:.56),angle:Math.random()*6,turn:(Math.random()-.5)*10,life:1.1+Math.random(),
        color:colors[i%colors.length],size:2.5+Math.random()*5.5});
    }
    if(!frame && !paused){previous=performance.now();frame=requestAnimationFrame(draw);}
  }
  function pause(value){paused=value;cancelAnimationFrame(frame);frame=0;if(!paused && particles.length){previous=performance.now();frame=requestAnimationFrame(draw);}}
  return {burst,pause,clear};
})();

<script id="bonus-games">const BonusStage = (() => {

      collect.disabled=bonus.total!==null||bonus.selected.length!==2;
    };
    bonus.values.forEach((v,i)=>choices.append(button(String(v),()=>{
      bonus.selected=bonus.selected.includes(i)?bonus.selected.filter(x=>x!==i):[...bonus.selected,i];sync();
    })));
    body.append(choices);sync();
    if(bonus.total===null)body.append(status,collect);
    else {
      const target=[...bonus.values].sort((a,b)=>b-a).slice(0,2);
      body.append(el("p","Collected "+bonus.total+" pts. Best pair · "+target.join(" + ")+" = "+(target[0]+target[1])+" pts.","dt-result"));
      body.append(button("Back to results",()=>{bonus=null;draw();},"dt-primary"));
    }
  }
  function draw(){
    body.replaceChildren();body.className="dt-body";
    if(review){if(review.choice===null)showPick(review);else showReveal(review);}
    else if(bonus)grab();
    else if(!match)showStart();
    else if(match.phase==="summary")summary();
    else {
      const round=match.rounds[match.index];
      body.append(el("p",R.games[match.game].title+" · Board "+(match.index+1)+" of 3 · "+match.level+"×","dt-note"));
      if(match.phase==="pick" && !round.stopped)spinningBoard(round);
      else if(match.phase==="pick")showPick(round);
      else showReveal(round);
    }
    dialog.scrollTop=0;
  }
  window.openDoubletake=()=>{
    focusOnRedraw=false;
    const active=document.querySelector(".machine").dataset.game;
    if(match && match.game!==active){match=null;bonus=null;review=null;}
    draw();
  };
})();
</script>
<script id="fleet">(() => {
  let channel="",last=-Infinity;
  addEventListener("message",e=>{if(e.source===parent && e.data?.type==="init" && typeof e.data.channel==="string")channel=e.data.channel;});
  function activity(e){if(!e.isTrusted || !channel || performance.now()-last<10000)return;last=performance.now();parent.postMessage({type:"activity",channel},"*");}
  addEventListener("pointerdown",activity);addEventListener("keydown",activity);
})();</script>
